title: Emergent LLM coding plus embedding-based consolidation pipeline for large-scale student-discourse taxonomies

description: The emote-aloud procedure is a modification of the cognitive-science think-aloud method in which participants state aloud the affective state they are feeling while working on a learning task.
title: Emote-aloud procedure for on-line identification of affective states during learning

description: The article recommends situating a planned or observed effect within the distribution of true effects from prior community college RCTs, by outcome and semester, instead of relying on Cohen's small/medium/large conventions.
title: Empirical percentile benchmarking of intervention effects for outcome- and semester-specific RCT planning
